name: Causari

latest_release.commit: pending: recorded by the commit after the tag

description: Measures how many lines from commits carrying machine-readable AI authorship metadata are still attributed to those commits by git blame at HEAD (counts, not grades), issues offline-verifiable Ed25519 Crovia Seals (crovia.seal.v1), diffs receipts along a single axis (causari.audit_diff.v1), and records local agent runtime declarations (.causari/ ledger) over CLI and MCP. version and method_version describe the published binary 0.5.0 (2026-10-21), method v6: that is what install.sh, cargo, npm and PyPI install. source_method_version is METHOD_VERSION in this source tree, also v6. No binary shipped method v5; 0.4.1 was method v4 (commit d4c4949, 2026-10-08) and measured Survival Reports #5 and #6.
disambiguation: Causari by Crovia Trust (causari.dev; crates.io/npm/PyPI package `causari`; MCP server `io.github.croviatrust/causari`). Not related to causari.ai, the GitHub organisation `causari`, or the npm scope `@causari`.

epistemic_limits.ai_tagged_is_not_ai_written: verified in audit JSON means git metadata matched a detection rule; it does not prove a model wrote the line.
epistemic_limits.unknown_is_not_human: UNKNOWN and untagged commits have no qualifying git metadata; they include human code, inline completions (Copilot, Cursor Tab), and untagged agent commits.
epistemic_limits.survival_is_not_quality: Survival is line persistence at HEAD under git blame -w -M -C, capped at introduced lines per commit. It is a count, not a grade.
epistemic_limits.signed_is_not_true: An Ed25519 seal proves integrity under the issuer public key (issuer_trust: unverified_offline), not that the numbers are true; rerun re audit on the commit to check.
epistemic_limits.egress_witness_scope: PNX shows that named assets shared no 47-byte substring with request bodies a witness saw; absence of observed egress is not proof that a job made no other connection.
